title: Inference
subtitle: The memory wall, the cache, the seating problem — four attacks on seven milliseconds

chapters.title: What Serving Actually Costs
chapters.blurb: Honest arithmetic for a 7B model: 7 ms per token, 0.6 percent of the compute used — the memory wall.

chapters.title: The Cache That Remembers
chapters.blurb: A real toy attention layer fills its cache on screen: 512 KB per token, 64 GB at batch 32 — 4.6 times the weights.

chapters.title: The Seating Problem
chapters.blurb: A real 24-request simulation: static batching 55 percent busy, continuous 76 — 1.37 times the throughput from scheduling alone.

chapters.title: Guess Four, Check Once
chapters.blurb: Draft and verify simulated for real: 2.77 tokens per pass at 70 percent agreement, about twice as fast end to end.

chapters.title: Shrink the Sweep Itself
chapters.blurb: A real int4 quantizer draws its own staircase — 11 percent measured error, and 143 to 667 tokens per second.
